falsifiable_claim: For the registered synthetic warehouse scenario, raising traffic_demand from its nearest registered lower level increases queue_growth under fixed remaining controls.
falsification_criterion: Reject if paired runs do not show a positive queue_growth change beyond the preregistered tolerance.
predicted_response: queue_growth is predicted to increase at the higher registered traffic-demand level.
assumptions: The scenario registry is the authority for permitted experiment values.
All parameters are synthetic and uncalibrated; effects require measured runs.
rationale: Higher registered task demand may increase queue pressure in the local discrete-event model; this is a provisional testable claim, not an established causal result.
